incident_text: A large smoke column over the fields, probably a grass fire. Nobody is nearby.

result.scene_summary: A large, smoky plume rises from a field of dry grass under a pale sky, with a fence and some dark shapes in the foreground.

observations.description: Large, dense, orange-brown smoke column rising from a field, obscuring part of the horizon.
A simple wire fence with posts is visible in the foreground, stretching horizontally across the image.
No people visible in the image.
Dry, yellowish grass covers the field. Some green vegetation is visible in the foreground.
Dark, indistinct shapes are visible in the distance, possibly livestock near the fence line.
